result.title: Genesis: Visual Augmentation Primitives for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
result.summary: Recent multimodal large language models achieve promising results on visual reasoning tasks, approaching human-level performance on existing STEM benchmarks. However, these capabilities degrade under complex real-world scenes. We identify that chain-of-thought reasoning remains largely confined to the linguistic space, rarely anchoring each step in visual evidence. The main cause is the absence of such data during training. In this work, we introduce a training data augmentation pipeline, \textbf{Visual Augmentation Primitives} (VAP), which leverages state-of-the-art vision generative models to synthesize diverse photorealistic training samples and corresponding reasoning text. VAP introduces some basic operators and applies them to a seed image and gets a variant. It also constructs coherent multimodal reasoning chains throughout the generation process. Such training data force models to perceive visual content and perform logical reasoning according to them at every step. We further introduce multimodal chain-of-thought rubric-based reinforcement learning to enhance this. It rewards not only text reasoning but also visual reasoning by scoring intermediate reasoning steps for logical validity, completeness, and consistency. Moreover, we construct the UNREAL benchmark to systematically evaluate visual reasoning on hyperrealistic scenes across controllable difficulty levels. Experiments show that a 4B model built on this framework surpasses 8B baselines, with performance improving consistently as the model scales to 32B, validating the scaling law for visual reasoning.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Visual Augmentation Primitives 训练数据增强流程：用视觉生成模型从种子图像合成多样逼真样本及对应推理文本，构建连贯的多模态推理链，并配合基于 rubric 的强化学习对中间步骤的逻辑性、完整性和一致性打分，同时构建 UNREAL 基准评估超写实场景的视觉推理。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文直接针对多模态 CoT 停留在语言空间、各步未锚定视觉证据的问题，与 LVR 关注的视觉旁路、证据筛选和轨迹监督密切相关，可供核查其合成数据与中间步骤奖励是否真正约束了视觉信息使用，不过其方法仍为训练期数据与奖励设计，未涉及 latent 状态生成。
